intro: Lazarus Group was the most frequently cited threat actor across 54 articles tagged social-engineering, published between April 8 and May 4, 2026. UNC6692 and APT37 (ScarCruft, InkySquid) were also prominent in the reporting. The coverage, which included 42 high-severity and 11 medium-severity items, primarily affected the cryptocurrency, financial services, technology, financial-services, and hospitality sectors. Observed impacts were global, with specific focus on North America, Europe, the United States, and Canada.
